title: Waiving the checklist — who, with a reason, shown on the quotation

steps.do: As Test BDM (the preparer, not an approver): look for "A point cannot be confirmed? Waive the checklist".
steps.expect: Not offered (or refused: "Only someone who may approve this quote can waive its checklist.").
steps.observed: Not offered to Test BDM (panel shows 5/7 done, no waiver link); sending a waiver anyway: "Only someone who may approve this quote can waive its checklist."

steps.do: As Test BranchMgr (approver): open "Waive the checklist", leave the reason empty.
steps.expect: Refused: "Say why the checklist is being waived — the reason is shown on the quote."
steps.observed: Refused, nothing waived — Nothing has been saved — Why — shown on the quote with your name still needs filling in.
steps.note: The empty reason is stopped in the browser before the server's sentence can be shown: "Nothing has been saved — Why — shown on the quote with your name still needs filling in.".
steps.suggest: Refused — the reason box must be filled in (the server's own sentence "Say why the checklist is being waived…" is a backstop).

steps.do: Reason "Bank guarantee terms come with the PO" → Waive.
steps.expect: Message "Checklist waived. The reason and your name are shown on the quote." Panel: "⚠ Waived by Test BranchMgr on <date> — Bank guarantee terms come with the PO". History has the waiver.
steps.observed: "Checklist waived. The reason and your name are shown on the quote." Panel: "⚠ Waived by Test BranchMgr on 15 Nov 2026 — Bank guarantee terms come with the PO"; History has the waiver.

steps.expect: The revision starts unticked and NOT waived.
steps.observed: Rev 01 shows "0/7 done" and no waiver line.

steps.do: Accept or lose the quotation, then try to change its ticks.
steps.expect: Refused: its checklist can no longer change.
steps.observed: Marked lost; the ticks are greyed out and a forced save is refused: "This quote is lost — its checklist can no longer change."
